corrected_text: LiteRtLockMetalMemory locks a MetalBufferPacked buffer in shared storage (contents available, length at least packed_bytes) in place: it returns the MTLBuffer's contents, and LiteRtUnlockMetalMemory then copies nothing (ours: 89137792). For every other buffer it allocates a posix_memalign host shadow of packed_bytes on first lock; a write-only lock doesn't download, and a read lock copies the GPU tensor into the shadow: a packed buffer via ReadDataFromBuffer (memcpy from contents when the buffer is MTLStorageModeShared, else a blit and wait), linear shared buffers whose type matches the host type via Agello's direct copy, others via ML Drift's ToDescriptor and ConvertDataFromDescriptor; LiteRtUnlockMetalMemory writes back after a write lock with the matching path (WriteDataToBuffer, direct write, or ConvertDataToDescriptor + UploadDescriptorData).
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: meaning changed. buffer_handler_metal.mm at b7b856a0 (89137792, 2026-11-13, in agello-one-20261115): LocksInPlace 492-503 (MetalBufferPacked, MTLStorageModeShared, contents non-null, length >= packed_bytes); the lock returns [buffer contents] for it before any shadow (581-585), and the unlock returns early for it (516-519). The shadow path (587-601 allocation, 603-607 write-only, 618-653 read, 531-562 write-back) and ReadDataFromBuffer/WriteDataToBuffer (275-284, 316-337) are unchanged, so in practice only a packed buffer that isn't shared (or too short) still goes through ReadDataFromBuffer.
